Cùm defcenderit pluuia aut nix de cœlo, rursus illuc non reuertitur, sed inebriat terram, facitq; vt pariat ipsa & producat; vt edat semen satori, & panem comedenti: Sic erit verbum meum quod egressum fuerit ex ore meo, non reuertetur ad me vacuum; sed faciet id, quo delector, & prosperabitur id quod emisero.

main_text.p: Luc.8.v.10. Vobis datum est nosse mysteria regni Dei. Confer v.15.

Act.16.v.14. Quædam autem mulier nomine Lydia, quæpurpuram vendebat in vrbe Thyatirorum, Deum colens, nos audiuit: cuius Dominus adaperuit cor, vt attenderet ea, quæ dicebantur à Paulo. Confer 1.Cor.1.v.24.& 2.Cor.2.v.16.
b) Luc.14. v. 18. & seqq. Omnes cœperunt vno ore se excusare, &c.

page.notes: The marginal numbers 5 and 10 are clear. The number beside "fundantur gaudio" is hard to read and is given as 15 with a doubt mark. The "a)" at the foot is a footnote line that runs on past this part. The small marks at the right margin beside the lines "emisero" and "alius" are unclear and are transcribed as [?]. The word "Quædam" is underlined in the scan. The lower-right "c) Act." is set apart as a foot note. The first line is a fragment continuing from the previous page.
